name: Zenithal-Hypostyle
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by towering mountain ranges. Beyond a nearby asteroid belt, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.

The terrain around the escape pod debris field is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on titanium, medicinal compounds and platinum are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
